scope: Reduce large curriculum autosave traffic in the main and Lite editors without weakening recovery or storage limits
implementation: Unchanged rows are referenced by UUID within the owned immutable baseRevision; edited and new rows remain complete objects
The ordered row array also preserves deletion and reordering
The server reconstructs and validates a complete snapshot before existing monotonic-sequence and discard-tombstone checks
Full-format requests remain supported; recovery responses and stored snapshots remain complete
The 2 MiB expanded snapshot allowance remains enforced and has a specific localized DRAFT_SIZE message
Lite uses the same implementation transpiled to ES5; no runtime dependency was added

measurement.method: Playwright captured actual POST JSON sizes. The comparison baseline is the full seeded snapshot JSON, excluding request metadata; this is a conservative approximate payload comparison, not a latency or physical device benchmark.

verification.legacyFirefox115: Actual ESR 115.40.0: compact KTP request observed, then import confirmation, collection/topic search, task editing, recovery, teacher approval and DOCX export passed on the current Windows host
securityCases: Unknown references and repeated row IDs rejected
Historical base revision used even after a newer canonical save
Compact and full requests above the allowance both rejected without storing a draft
verification.reliability: Both editors retain the second edit made while the first backup acknowledgement is delayed; full saved snapshots retain all 2000 rows and source metadata

limitations: Current local host and synthetic data; no physical Windows 7 or low-end device benchmark
Full snapshots remain stored in PostgreSQL; this change does not claim to reduce database storage or WAL traffic
Last unacknowledged edits still require keeping the tab open
Deploy the compatible backend before publishing the new frontend
No public deployment or paid AI calls in this verification batch
